description: Delimits a use case's boundary and emits the parent spec that the layer skills detail — trigger, payload, response, side effects, invariants, errors, and canonical names. Use when the request involves "new use case", "design before implementing", "implementation spec", a new endpoint/event/job, or when a request bundles several actions and it's necessary to know whether it's one use case or several. First piece of the `/new-feature` pipeline.
